questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

The integration of cutting - edge technologies into the healthcare industry __have the prospect__ of revolutionising the way medical professionals provide patient care.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "has the prospect."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence is in the present tense, so the verb should also be in the present tense.
 
• The error lies in the Subject Verb agreement.
 
• The subject "integration of cutting - edge technologies" is singular, so we need a singular helping verb** "has"** with it.
 
• **"Has the prospect" **means that there is a possibility or likelihood of something happening in the future, which fits the meaning of the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

Correct sentence: *The integration of cutting - edge technologies into the healthcare industry has the prospect__ of revolutionising the way medical professionals provide patient care.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information​__*

 
• "Were the potential" is incorrect because "were" is past tense and does not match the present tense of the rest of the sentence.
 
• "Have the potential" is grammatically correct, but "has the prospect" is a better fit in terms of meaning.
 
• **"Will have potential"** is incorrect because it changes the meaning of the sentence to suggest that the potential is not currently present, but will be in the future.

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The tiger was killed on an unfortunate day by a hostile hunter.

options.text: A hostile hunter had killed the tiger on an unfortunate day.
A hostile hunter kills the tiger on an unfortunate day.
The tiger is killed by a hostile hunter on an unfortunate day.
A hostile hunter killed the tiger on an unfortunate day.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "A hostile hunter killed the tiger on an unfortunate day."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the Passive Voice. It is in Simple Past Tense.
 
• As per the given question, we must change it to Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• In the passive voice, the action "killing" is performed by the doer "tiger."
 
• "Hostile" is the subject and "tiger" is the object in the active voice.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *A hostile hunter killed the tiger on an unfortunate day.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that correctly expresses the following sentence in passive voice.**

Are you delivering the pizza?

options.text: Has the pizza delivered by you?
Were the pizza being delivered by you?
Is the pizza being delivered by you?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Is the pizza being delivered by you?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Present Continuous Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Is/am/are + Subject + v1 + ing+ object? (Active Voice)__
 
• Is/am/are + Object + was/were + being + V3 + by Subject? __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Was Esha singing a song?** *(Active Voice)
 
• *Was a song being sung by Esha?** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'you'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'pizza'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'Is delivering' will be changed into 'is being delivering'. 
 
• "Pizza" is a singular subject, so we must "is" with it.
 
• The correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *Is the pizza being delivered by you?*

questions.question:
**Direction: Choose the correct meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The government is planning a new policy to help the **__immigrants__** coming from the neighbouring country.

options.text: Someone who leaves one country to settle in another
Someone who goes to visit a new country for a short time

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Someone who leaves one country to settle in another."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"immigrants"** refers to people who are moving from one country to another to settle there permanently. (दूसरे देश में आकर वहीं स्‍थायी रूप से बसने वाला व्‍यक्ति; आप्रवासी)

 
 
• **Example**: *The government plans to tighten controls to prevent illegal **immigrants**__.*
 
 
 
• The suffix **"-ants"** in **"immigrants"** indicates a person who performs a particular action (in this case, leaving their country to settle elsewhere).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
